audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially in 3D printing, CAD visualization, and web 3D asset preparation workflows.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files through Scene.open() with automatic format detection from file extension or explicit FileFormat.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Writes scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression, coordinate flipping, and unit scaling.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build meshes from control points and polygons, or convert parameterized primitives to editable meshes via to_mesh().
capabilities.title: Construct and edit meshes

capabilities.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.
capabilities.title: Assign materials to geometry

capabilities.text: Create hierarchical scenes using Scene, Node, and Transform objects with support for child nodes and independent transforms per node.
capabilities.title: Build scene graphs

capabilities.text: Convert arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans using PolygonModifier.triangulate() with real ear-clipping implementation.
capabilities.title: Triangulate polygon meshes

capabilities.text: Build keyframe animation with AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence, and store skeletal bind-pose data with Pose.
capabilities.title: Support keyframe animation

limitations.text: FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() and save_to_stream() raise NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError.
Texture and TextureBase raise NotImplementedError on construction, so image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic 3D scene creation, modification, and export to common formats (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF) using a pure-Python API.
Eliminates the need for native runtimes or external SDKs by providing a fully Python-implemented 3D processing library.
Supports parameterized primitives and direct mesh editing for custom geometry generation.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond those explicitly listed in format:input.* and format:output.* facts is unclear; the README mentions FBX import but facts do not confirm it as a supported input format.
Whether the library supports binary STL export beyond ASCII STL (example:009 shows ASCII STL output) is not confirmed by facts.
The scope of 'experimental' FBX support beyond tokenizer tests is not verified by facts.
Whether the library supports animation export beyond import is not confirmed by facts.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect geometry via Node/Entity/Mesh objects.

workflows.name: Export scenes to target formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, or 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for compression and coordinate system control.

workflows.name: Build scenes from primitives
workflows.text: Construct parameterized primitives like Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and others, then convert them to editable meshes using to_mesh().

workflows.name: Assign materials to geometry
workflows.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygon meshes
workflows.text: Convert arbitrary polygon data into triangle fans using PolygonModifier.triangulate() with real ear-clipping implementation.

workflows.name: Build meshes from control points
workflows.text: Create meshes vertex-by-vertex using Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon(), then export to formats like glTF or STL.
